headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 8, 2026**
article:
The New York Yankees edged out the Atlanta Braves 5-4 in a closely contested game, with Gerrit Cole leading the way. In other action, the Oakland Athletics secured a 7-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Tyler Soderstrom hitting a home run and driving in one run.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Griffin Jax (right elbow discomfort) and Cooper Pratt (right hamstring strain), who have both been placed on the injured list. Additionally, Jack Leiter has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to a right ankle posterior impingement.

The Athletics made a notable trade, acquiring Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins also made a series of trades, sending Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for Brandan Bidois, Brian Sanchez, and Hyun Seung Lee.

top_news.title: **Braves Fall Short in Bronx Showdown**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees edged out the Atlanta Braves 5-4 in a closely contested game. Gerrit Cole led the Yankees to victory with a strong 7.0 innings pitched performance, striking out 9 batters and allowing just 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Athletics Take Down Red Sox 7-3**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics secured a 7-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Tyler Soderstrom leading the team at the plate. Soderstrom hit a home run and drove in one run, while Gage Jump earned the win with 6 strong innings.

top_news.title: **Marlins Shut Out Angels 7-0**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins dominated the Los Angeles Angels in a 7-0 victory, with Sandy Alcantara leading the way on the mound. Alcantara pitched 7.0 innings, striking out 8 batters and allowing no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Phillies 7-5**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 7-5 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Nathan Lukes leading the offense. Lukes hit 3 home runs, including a key 6th homer that scored Brandon Valenzuela.

top_news.title: **Reds Fall to Nationals in One-Sided Affair**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals dominated the Cincinnati Reds 7-1, handing them a tough loss. Impact hitters for the Nationals included Abimelec Ortiz, Daylen Lile, Jorbit Vivas, and Keibert Ruiz.

top_news.title: **Athletics Edge Red Sox in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics secured a narrow win over the Boston Red Sox, taking the final score 4-3. Impact players for the Athletics included Henry Bolte and Eli White.

top_news.title: **Rays RHP Griffin Jax Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Tampa Bay Rays right-hander Griffin Jax has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow discomfort, effective retroactive to August 6, 2026.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have bolstered their lineup with the addition of 1B Jacob Berry, who was traded to the team. Berry joins the Royals after being acquired in a trade.
